python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np
img2 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0002.png')

# Print leg regions:
# Let's inspect where all 4 legs touch the floor
# Find connected components of brown pixels
brown_mask = (img2[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img2[:, :, 2] < 180) & (img2[:, :, 0] < 50)
import scipy.ndimage as ndi
labels, n = ndi.label(brown_mask)
print('Found components:', n)

# Let's look at vertical columns across the image
for c in range(0, 512, 10):
    rows = np.where(brown_mask[:, c])[0]
    if len(rows) > 0:
        print(f'col {c}: r in [{rows.min()}, {rows.max()}]')
"
